release_notes: Oracle Windows Production 18.13.56N8. Adds the verified ETH replacement module for Paper and Live trading, including position tape, active-position banner, rollover settlement, and stop controls. Application Settings now uses one continuous page for reliable smaller-screen scrolling. Preserves the verified BTC module, laptop-portable runtime protections, and existing Live risk/pretrade safeguards. SOL remains disabled while its replacement module is pending.
